claims.author: ismaelsadeeq
claims.question: Should AssumeUTXO removal follow the usual deprecate-then-remove approach?
claims.quote: should we do it through the usual deprecate then remove style?

claims.author: ariard
claims.quote: it would has been possible to find an intermediary technical solution, where we would have kept the AssumeUTXO feature has an optional special build flag side-companion process available through a new `ipc/capnp/sidevalidation.cpp`
claims.request: Consider keeping AssumeUTXO as an optional special build flag side-companion process via IPC (`ipc/capnp/sidevalidation.cpp`) to reduce maintenance burden on libbitcoinkernel while preserving the feature

claims.harm: Removing AssumeUTXO removes a major bootstrapping advantage (downloading/processing 100x less data), creating incentives to use non-Core clients, and the feature is unlikely to return; background validation should be dropped first instead
claims.quote: I'm concept NACK on actually removing AssumeUTXO. I think we should drop background validation first, as I suggested in #36557.
